text: Arundhati Roy's The God of Small Things was followed by an obscenity case in Kerala in 1997. In an interview published on September 30, 1997, Roy was reported to face obscenity charges brought by an individual lawyer, Sabu Thomas. She said she had appealed to the high court the previous week, and that the court decided to give the case to a lower court.
